messages.content: On Monday the post office delivered 425 letters, 120 of which were sent abroad. On Tuesday they delivered 17 more than one-fifth as many as Monday. On Wednesday they delivered 5 more than twice as many as they delivered on Tuesday. How many letters did the post office deliver Monday - Wednesday?

content.text:
# Solving Step by Step

**Monday:** 425 letters

**Tuesday:** 17 more than one-fifth of Monday's deliveries
$$\frac{1}{5} \times 425 + 17 = 85 + 17 = 102 \text{ letters}$$

**Wednesday:** 5 more than twice Tuesday's deliveries
$$2 \times 102 + 5 = 204 + 5 = 209 \text{ letters}$$

**Total (Monday–Wednesday):**
$$425 + 102 + 209 = \boxed{736 \text{ letters}}$$
